app.title: Beach Ball Merge
app.tagline: Join two matching balls to make a bigger one!
app.subtitle: A sporty merge puzzle on the beach
ui.howto.title: How to Play
ui.howto.1: Aim left or right, then click (or lift your finger) to drop a ball.
ui.howto.2: When two identical balls touch, they merge into the next size up.
ui.howto.3: Game over if a ball stays above the orange dotted line for over 2 seconds!
ui.keys: Keyboard: ← → move · Space drop · P pause · M sound
